title: kith-jmap: MAX_CALLS_IN_REQUEST const diverges silently from session capability
description: parse_request enforces MAX_CALLS_IN_REQUEST=16 at line 14, but build_session advertises max_calls_in_request: 16 as a separate literal at line 213. If one is changed, the other silently diverges — clients see a different limit than what the parser enforces. Fix: reference MAX_CALLS_IN_REQUEST as u32 in the CoreCapability literal.
